regions.today: A mix of sunny spells and isolated showers. Light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells at first tonight. It will turn cloudier overnight with outbreaks of rain spreading from the west, with heavier bursts by dawn. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees with light westerly winds becoming moderate southerly with the rain.
regions.tomorrow: A dull and wet morning with widespread rain at first. Rain will become patchier through the morning, but it will remain cloudy and damp through the day with some mist and hill fog. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees with moderate to fresh southwest winds, easing by evening.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Thursday. Moderate to high on Friday.
